  Readable gloss: "This verbal adjective from εὐλογέω ('to bless') is a term of high liturgical register, used in the New Testament almost exclusively of God or Christ. Paul's declaration that Christ is 'God over all, blessed forever' (Rom 9:5) presses the term into a Christological claim. Spanish bendito and French béni reflect the same devotional weight, marking the word as belonging to worship rather than casual speech."
